title: Mirabel and the Portrait
author: Silas Thornbury
blurb: Emrys Winterbourne, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
